title: Kelowna Platinum Wine Tour Full Day Guided With 5 Wineries
includes: Hotel & Accommodation pickup and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to our most exclusive Kelowna Platinum Wine Tour. Set amongst the rolling hills of Okanagan Wine Country, this full day elevated private wine touring and tasting experience is designed to highlight the best of Okanagan wineries. Handpicked wine selections are paired with vineyard walks, barrel room tastings, charcuterie and cheese boards, and intimate conversations with winemakers.

Focused on Library and Reserve wines, this uncompromising Kelowna Platinum Wine Tour experience includes stops at 5 award winning wineries as well as lunch reservations at a stunning winery restaurant.

With 30-35 wine tastings, access to reserve vintages, educational sessions in the vineyard and exclusive barrel room experiences, this private wine tour is for those seeking the most experiential and exclusive wine tour in the region! 

This private tour requires a minimum of 6 guests.
